name: Nutrition
line: Seasonal, local and predominantly organic plant-based nourishment, guided by a paddock to plate philosophy and the Mediterranean dietary pattern

line_source.section: Pillar grid (the ten are repeated three times in the page markup, identical text)

evidence.heading: The Mediterranean Diet
claims: Reduces cardiovascular disease, CVD events, and all-cause mortality. (Martinez-Lacoba et al., 2018; Pant et al., 2023)
Lowers risk of age-related cognitive disorders including dementia and AD. (Fekete et al., 2021)
Improves mood and reduces depression risk via anti-inflammatory and gut-microbiome pathways. (Lai et al., 2023)
Enhances gut health by increasing microbial diversity and SCFA production. (Estruch et al., 2022)

evidence.heading: Plant-based diets
claims: Reduce risk of major chronic diseases. (Wang et al., 2023)

evidence.heading: Organic diets
claims: Lower pesticide exposure and may improve select metabolic/reproductive markers. (Jiang et al., 2024)
